name: What should I prepare before starting a kitchen remodel?

mainEntity.name: What should I prepare before starting a kitchen remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before starting a kitchen remodel, it's beneficial to have a clear idea of your budget, desired style, and functional needs. Gather inspiration photos, make a list of 'must-haves' versus 'nice-to-haves,' and consider how you'll manage without a functional kitchen during construction. Having these details ready helps streamline the design consultation and material selection phases with your contractor.
acceptedAnswer.description: Prepare by defining your budget, style, and functional needs. Gather inspiration and list 'must-haves' to streamline the process.
